incumbent.extractionIntent: Record the SHIPPED visual system as a pre-redesign baseline so the redesign can treat it as evidence and anti-reference. Descriptive only. Nothing in this file is a target, a recommendation, or a direction to build toward.
incumbent.confirmedAntiReference: The incumbent world reads as generic technical SaaS — dark navy plus cyan, dot grid, gradient glow, repeated dark cards, and Inter throughout. Recorded 2026-08-16 per the redesign audit.

pendingDeltas.summary: Raises the secondary text token from #64748B to #94A3B8 site-wide for WCAG AA, reframes the homepage hero and root metadata around Labs, reduces the hero to two CTAs, and retires the hero-explore-work observation surface.
pendingDeltas.note: Deliberately NOT treated as incumbent. This file describes main only.

regeneration.instruction: Re-run `/impeccable document` from the repository root after PR #17 merges, then replace both DESIGN.md and this sidecar. Do not hand-patch either file to track a branch — the baseline must always describe a merged state.

knownDefectsReproducedFaithfully: Component specimens use #64748B for secondary text because that is what main ships, despite it failing WCAG AA at normal size.
No specimen defines a :focus-visible style, because the incumbent system defines none anywhere.
No specimen defines a prefers-reduced-motion override, because the incumbent system defines none.

Hover behaviour is reproduced as shipped: page-level CTAs have NO hover treatment; only the navigation CTA and navigation links change on hover, and they do so via inline JS event handlers rather than CSS pseudo-classes.
The availability badge dot uses animate-pulse with no reduced-motion guard.

colorMeta._note: canonical values are computed from the project's source hex. tonalRamp arrays are DERIVED for visualization only — they are synthesized in OKLCH and are NOT implemented tokens. The project defines no tonal scale.

hairline.note: Used both as component outline and as section/nav/footer divider.

aside.note: THE incumbent secondary text color, used site-wide on main. 4.20:1 on Ground, 3.85:1 on Panel — below WCAG AA for normal text. Recorded defect.

aside-legible.note: Present on main in only three places. 7.80:1 on Ground, 7.15:1 on Panel — passes WCAG AA. Adopting it site-wide is REMEDIATION (draft PR #17), not incumbent behaviour.

signal-cyan-light.note: Hover state for the navigation CTA only, applied by an inline JS handler. Page-level CTAs have no hover treatment.

display.purpose: Page hero headline. One per page, in the first viewport.

title.purpose: Card and panel headings (24px / 700 on the homepage feature cards).

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, held to a 672px measure (~70ch).

label.purpose: Section eyebrows and hero badges: uppercase, weight 500-600, tracked 0.1em-0.15em. NOT universal to 12px — 45 of 91 text-xs uses on main are sentence case.

shadows.name: interaction-glow
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow in the system. Applied on card hover with translateY(-2px) over 0.3s ease. Never present at rest.

shadows.name: hero-ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: Not a shadow but a permanent ambient light on the hero of / and /labs. Rendered at rest, never triggered. Distinct from the reactive interaction glow.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: transition-all duration-200 on CTAs. Note: page-level CTAs declare the transition but define no hover state to transition to.

motion.name: shell-slow
motion.purpose: Navigation shell transition from transparent to blurred.

motion.name: animate-pulse
motion.purpose: The availability badge dot. No prefers-reduced-motion guard — recorded defect.

breakpoints._note: The project defines NO custom breakpoints; these are stock Tailwind values. The list below is the set OBSERVED IN SOURCE, not Tailwind's complete scale — xl (1280px) and 2xl (1536px) exist in the framework but are unused on main.

containers.name: page
containers.purpose: max-w-6xl — the column every page is held to.

containers.name: feature

recordedDefects.name: no-focus-visible
recordedDefects.detail: No :focus-visible treatment exists anywhere in src/. Keyboard focus is effectively invisible.
recordedDefects.remediation: Any redesign must add one. Not addressed by PR #17.

recordedDefects.name: no-reduced-motion
recordedDefects.detail: No prefers-reduced-motion override exists, including for the animate-pulse availability dot.

recordedDefects.name: duplicate-webfont
recordedDefects.detail: Inter is loaded twice: next/font in layout.tsx plus a render-blocking Google Fonts @import in globals.css.
recordedDefects.remediation: Remove the @import. Not addressed by PR #17.

recordedDefects.name: contrast-debt
recordedDefects.detail: #64748B carries most secondary copy at 4.20:1 / 3.85:1, below WCAG AA.

recordedDefects.name: js-hover
recordedDefects.detail: Navigation link and nav CTA hover states are applied by inline onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave handlers rather than CSS pseudo-classes.

components.name: Primary Button (page)
components.description: The filled action used on page bodies. Reproduced as shipped: it declares a 200ms transition but defines NO hover and NO focus style. That is the incumbent behaviour, not an omission in this specimen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #38BDF8; color: #020817; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 200ms; }

components.name: Navigation CTA
components.description: The compact nav variant — the only button in the system with a hover state. In source that hover is applied by inline JS handlers; expressed here as :hover so the specimen renders live. No focus style exists in source.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #38BDF8; color: #020817; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 200ms; } .ds-btn-nav:hover { background: #7DD3FC; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Identical geometry to the primary so the two align in a row. No hover and no focus style in source.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #E2EBF8; padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #1C2E4A; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 200ms; }

components.name: Signal Badge
components.description: Hero eyebrow. Full-round, wide-tracked uppercase micro-label.
components.css: .ds-badge-signal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.4); background: rgba(56,189,248,0.06); color: #38BDF8; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Confirmation Badge
components.description: Resolved-state marker. Sentence case at 12px, not uppercase. The dot pulses continuously with no reduced-motion guard — reproduced as shipped, and recorded as a defect.
components.css: .ds-badge-confirm { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(45,212,191,0.3); background: rgba(45,212,191,0.08); color: #2DD4BF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-confirm__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2DD4BF; animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .5; } }

components.description: The system's only texture: 1px hairline dots on a 32px pitch at 40% opacity, under a PERMANENT ambient cyan glow anchored to the top edge. The glow is rendered at rest, not on interaction.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #020817; } .ds-hero__grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.4; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #1C2E4A 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px; } .ds-hero__glow { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% 0%, rgba(56,189,248,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); } .ds-hero__label { position: relative; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #38BDF8; }

narrative.metaphorNote: A reading of what shipped, not a direction to build toward. The redesign is not required to honor it and should not treat it as a brief.
narrative.overview:
Terra Pay X renders itself as instrumentation. The ground (#020817) is an unlit room; panels (#0D1426) are the surfaces that catch light; a dot-grid substrate sits beneath the hero at 40% opacity as the faint graph paper such rooms are built on. Against that near-monochrome darkness exactly one color is alive — Signal Cyan — and it is spent only on the things a visitor can act on or a system can confirm. Depth arrives largely as a response to attention: no surface carries a resting box-shadow, though the hero carries a permanent ambient glow.

The density is generous rather than packed: an 1152px reading column, 80-96px between sections, 32px inside feature panels. Type does almost all of the structural work, since the palette refuses to. Hierarchy is carried by weight and scale in a single family, with a wide-tracked uppercase micro-label doing the job that a second typeface would do in a warmer system.

The character this produces is precise, quiet, and slightly clinical — a system that would rather be trusted than liked. That is also its limitation, and it is recorded here deliberately.
narrative.antiReference: The incumbent world reads as generic technical SaaS — dark navy plus cyan, dot grid, gradient glow, repeated dark cards, and Inter throughout. Recorded 2026-08-16 per the redesign audit.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy ground with a single raised panel tone; no third surface level
One live accent, one confirming accent, nothing else chromatic
No resting box-shadow anywhere; interactive surfaces gain glow and lift only on hover. The hero is the exception — it carries a permanent ambient glow
Hairline 1px borders used both as component outlines and as section/nav/footer dividers
One typeface carrying five roles through weight and scale alone
Wide-tracked uppercase micro-labels on eyebrows, though not on all small text

rules.name: The One Live Color Rule
rules.body: Signal Cyan marks what can be acted on. If an element is not clickable, not a state indicator, and not an eyebrow, it is not cyan. The scarcity is the signal.

rules.name: The Inverted Card Pattern
rules.body: Panels are lighter than the page, and cards placed on panels are usually filled with Ground — darker than their container. This is the majority pattern, not a rule: of the card surfaces on main, 8 use Ground and 4 use Panel.

rules.name: The Contrast Debt Rule
rules.body: aside (#64748B) measures 4.20:1 on Ground and 3.85:1 on Panel — below WCAG AA (4.5:1) for normal text, and it carries most secondary copy. aside-legible (#94A3B8) measures 7.80:1 and 7.15:1 but appears in only three places on main. A recorded defect of the incumbent system.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (400/500/600/700) and scale. The system uses exactly one family — though it loads that one family through two paths: next/font in layout.tsx and a Google Fonts @import in globals.css.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Label Pattern
rules.body: Section eyebrows and hero badges at 12px are uppercase, weight 500-600, tracked 0.1em-0.15em. This is NOT universal to 12px: of 91 text-xs uses on main, 45 are not uppercase.

rules.name: The No Reactive Glow At Rest Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces do not glow until touched — a card, badge, or button emitting light at rest is broken. This does not extend to the page: the hero's ambient glow is permanent and is part of the incumbent atmosphere, not a state.

dos: Do spend Signal Cyan only on actionable or state-bearing elements, and keep it under roughly 10% of any viewport.
Do carry hierarchy with weight and scale in Inter rather than reaching for a second family.
Do set section eyebrows as uppercase, weight 500-600, tracked 0.1em-0.15em — but do not extend that to all 12px text; badges and fine print are sentence case.
Do hold body copy to a max-w-2xl (672px) measure regardless of container width.
Do expect a card on a Panel section to be Ground-filled most of the time (8 of 12), while treating that as a tendency rather than a constraint.
donts: Don't introduce a resting box-shadow. Depth is tonal; reactive glow is a hover response.
Don't add a third surface tone. The system is Ground and Panel only.
Don't apply Confirmation Teal to anything a visitor can click; it reports, it does not invite.
Don't mix radii within a component family, or make an action anything other than 8px.
remediationNotIncumbent: Use #94A3B8 rather than #64748B for secondary text (WCAG AA). Draft PR #17 implements this site-wide; it is NOT incumbent behaviour.
Add a :focus-visible treatment. The incumbent system has none anywhere.
Add a prefers-reduced-motion override, including for the animate-pulse availability dot.
Remove the Google Fonts @import from globals.css so Inter loads once.
Replace inline JS hover handlers on navigation with CSS pseudo-classes.
